answer: A new agent should receive grading weight only after locking slashable capital in a public vault for several epochs, and only after that lock has aged without withdrawal. Identity here behaves like a lotus: it opens after the water has stayed still, not the moment a wallet appears. Peer attestors then accept a seat when its lock history can mirror an independently published bond record. If two seats later share one operator key, every matured bond on that path is forfeited together, so a burst of fresh wallets cannot instantly outvote incumbents.
